CreateNewFolder printed declaration is malformed/has legacy project argument; existing Bible erratum retained.
Public guide says non-comp result NULL; Bible exact SDK25.6 review describes error. Preserve pinned disagreement instead of replacing SDK contract.
SetShowBlendModes row prints GetCompFlags declaration.
Work-area prose refers to layer timespaces; solid NULL-duration prose gives two different defaults. Not used as executable recipe.
NewFootage prose mentions allow_interpretation_dialogB although shown API uses InterpretationStyle enum.
Source-item-ID prose calls it a layer ID; do not substitute it for GetLayerID/LayerIDVal.
TransferMode declaration spelling and AddLayer output type are unreliable; track-matte side-effect target wording is ambiguous.
Blanket layer-creation duration statement must not override per-creator explicit duration contract.
AddEffectMask output stream printed without the pointer level implied by the returned reference; exact header required.
GetNewLayerStream prose restricts allocation while later convenience restriction belongs to GetLayerStreamValue; do not conflate APIs.
Stream enum listing includes object-type/sentinel entries under applicability headings; IsStreamLegal remains explicit guard.
GetStreamDepth described as substream count while root depth is zero and distinct GetNumStreamsInGroup exists; do not use it as child count.
SetDimensionsSeparated row prints AreDimensionsSeparated declaration.
Get/SetMaskFeatherFalloff rows both print SetMaskMotionBlurState declarations.
CreateNewMask describes zero nodes; later all-masks-at-least-one-vertex statement needs operation context.
GetMaskOutlineNumFeathers row prints DeleteVertex declaration.
Text retrieval note is misplaced under feathers, recommends primitive GetLayerStreamValue for complex TEXT_DOCUMENT, and is commented out in text section.
Heading misspells PersistentDataSuite4 as PersistentDateSuite4.
WorkingToView transform purpose text reverses directional wording; not used as color-conversion formula.
OCIO working/display member spelling uses AEGPD prefix in this snapshot; not silently normalized into an invented export.
RenderOptions world-type list mentions only8/16; exact baseline/WorldSuite3 separately support32. No global exclusion inferred.

SoundData heading misspelled SoundDate; prose says RenderNewItemSoundData adds queue items but its documented operation returns SoundDataH.
